Request of Councilmembers Brock and de la Torre that the City Council direct the City Manager to provide an update via an Information Item to be published on the City’s website regarding bicycle and pedestrian improvements installed on 17th Street from Pico to Wilshire, known as the “Safe Streets for 17th Street and Michigan Avenue” project, upon completion of the project.
